entries.text: I am currently feeling somewhat energetic and active

I Slept very good last night . Going on a little getaway with my family this weekend so I’m excited about that . Watch football and hockey last night and my team won finishing up one of the seasons of my show and I’m happy about that .

Kind of tired . Might take a nap . Good football game on tonight . Excited to watch that . Then hockey is on so happy to watch that . Caught up on work this morning from this week of school that I missed . Felt happy I started doing stuff again , related to school .

Feeling not as sick anymore , the medicine is really working . I am doing some work that I missed this week . I am going away this weekend on a little getaway . Excited and happy about that . I like my new TV show . I’m watching .

I’m feeling pretty good . Not happy or sad . Medicine kicked in and I feel better . Will probably feel sick again once the medicine wears off . Not going back to school today I don’t know about tomorrow yet . I’ve just been watching TV in my bed all day .

Feeling not happy but not sad . I slept a lot better last night . still have fever and still feel sick . going back to school today I don’t know about tomorrow yet . Just been watching TV laying on bed past few days .

The medicine is wearing off . I’m starting to feel sick again . I’m still happy and excited to go back to school tomorrow . I’m going to take the medicine again . Hopefully I sleep better tonight because last night I didn’t sleep too good I took another nap before dinner now I’m just watching a new TV show before Football starts . Feeling happy .

I’m feeling a little happier . My medicine is working and I am feeling better . I took a nap so I’m not as tired . I didn’t sleep as good last night . I just cleaned my car so I’m happy that it’s clean . I am going back to school tomorrow and I’m excited about that .

I am feeling better . Originally was sick but am feeling better . Not as hot anymore . Have school tomorrow but I am not going . Don’t have practice but have lift but missing that too . Feel happier because I am feeling better .

I am currently sick . I think I have the flu . I have chills and I’m sweating . I stayed in bed all day and I don’t feel good . I didn’t eat a lot today . I only had peanut butter and jelly and some oatmeal

I’m feeling tired . Didn’t sleep good last night . Hungry too because I didn’t have breakfast yet . But I’m excited to watch college football today . Might take a nap soon . Going to birthday party later so excited for that .
